catalog_title: iDEAL Application Database – User Question Catalog (Access-Tiered)
description: Questions split into two access tiers. Admin/Superuser can ask all questions. Regular users can only query information about themselves or data directly related to them.

access_levels.admin: Admin User / Superuser – full visibility across all users, departments, returns, logs, and system configuration.
access_levels.self: Regular User – restricted to their own profile, their department's returns, their role's permissions, and their own submissions only.
